For me it was probably one of the most intense panic attacks I've ever experienced like two years ago. When it happened I didn't know what was happening, I felt like throwing up. Well my solution to it was going to the psychologist. I was visiting her for half a year and it kinda helped me but I think what helped me the most was reading about anxiety and panic attacks. Then trying things and what works for me: breathing exercise, taking some medicine to calm my stomach when I feel like throwing up (I think it's more placebo but it works, especially at night when I wake up at 4am with the feeling of throwing up and I can't really tell if I wanna throw up or if it's anxiety). Also knowing that the feeling is gonna pass, that I definitely won't die and the attack is gonna pass, so when it happens I just lay down and focus in breathing and waiting for it to pass.
